hooks.name: Privacy boundary review
hooks.description: After the agent saves a file on a privacy boundary (native code, backend, photo upload, capture, consent, job text, try-on, report, API and Tauri adapters, consent and policy contracts), review the diff for leaks and excessive permissions.

action.prompt: A privacy-sensitive file was just saved. Apply .kiro/prompts/privacy-review.md to the current diff (`git diff`). List release-blocking findings with file references, and do not make silent security tradeoffs.
